inspection_method: shallow git clone plus README, package scripts, Eleventy helper/component tree, note-settings docs, build-pipeline docs, access-token docs, and Obsidian Bases docs

anchors.why: Identifies the template for the Digital Garden Obsidian Plugin and documents extensive CSS customization variables.
Defines Eleventy, Sass, theme-fetch, build, start, and test scripts with Node runtime expectations.
Documents global and note-specific publication settings such as search, graph, backlinks, TOC, filetree, and frontmatter overrides.
Documents user setup hooks for Eleventy and markdown-it customization.
Recommends repo-scoped access tokens rather than broad account tokens.
Documents that Bases queries run at build time against published notes only and may differ from the local vault.

known_limits: Publishing settings are projection controls, not review approval.
Graph/search/backlinks/Bases output are public-site views, not reviewed relations or evidence support.
Access tokens and build hooks require security review before any VAKS use.
